negative_findings: No researched declaration field consumes a universal financial event, graph edge, purchase-to-sale relation or purchase-commission-to-sale relation.
The declaration consumes source rows, income-group aggregates and Appendix 8 category aggregates.
A more specific relation may still be required by the tax methodology that computes an aggregate; G5.40A does not invent it.
Synthetic repository fixtures do not prove real taxpayer facts or real broker-document coverage.
Zero is not evidence of absence: conditional fields require explicit bounded non-activation or completeness evidence.
